title: Like it
body: I like that it’s bright and cheerful. I like how I can see days where I have completed everything on the calendar and I really like that I can schedule something as anytime on a given day. It would be helpful if I could check things off on a day that has passed since sometimes I’m building the habits but forget to check them off on the actual day.
author: exasperated student

title: Very basic app
body: I got an ad about the app and how it can create customized routines for you based on your MBTI. I was interested and paid premium with the newcomer discount thinking I would get premium capabilities. The difference between basic and premium is not much. Not worth it at all to get the subscription. Plus they didn’t even have the MBTI personalized routine, so that was a lie. On top of that, the “personalized” routines are so basic they seem AI-generated. Was not helpful at all. I would get a better personalized routine using ChatGPT for free. Just a pretty app with basic content.
